title: Resolving a disagreement at work
objectives: Acknowledge the idea and explain a concern
Agree on who will take the next action

courseTemplate.setting: There is time to improve checkout before launch, but a full redesign would push back the deadline.

roles.learner: A colleague protecting a release deadline

courseTemplate.openingLine: I think we should redesign the whole flow before shipping.

targetPatterns.pattern: I see why, but a full redesign would push us past the deadline.
targetPatterns.example: I see why, but a full redesign would push us past the deadline.

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's fix checkout now and redesign the rest after launch.
targetPatterns.example: Let's fix checkout now and redesign the rest after launch.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll check with engineering and bring an estimate to tomorrow's stand-up.
targetPatterns.example: I'll check with engineering and bring an estimate to tomorrow's stand-up.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you take a look at my draft when you get a chance?
targetPatterns.example: Could you take a look at my draft when you get a chance?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll own the report, and you handle the data part.
targetPatterns.example: I'll own the report, and you handle the data part.
targetPatterns.translation: 我负责报告，你负责数据部分。

targetPatterns.pattern: Sorry, I dropped the ball on this one.
targetPatterns.example: Sorry, I dropped the ball on this one.

targetPatterns.pattern: I don't want to step on your toes.
targetPatterns.example: I don't want to step on your toes.
targetPatterns.translation: 我不想越界干涉你的工作。

targetPatterns.pattern: Can we align on the deadline first?
targetPatterns.example: Can we align on the deadline first?

targetPatterns.translation: 谢谢你提前提出这个问题。

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll loop in the design team.
targetPatterns.example: I'll loop in the design team.
targetPatterns.translation: 我会把设计团队拉进来。

stages.title: Acknowledge the idea and explain a concern
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I think we should redesign the whole flow before shipping.”
successCriteria: The learner can acknowledge the idea and explain a concern in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I see why, but …”

stages.title: Propose a phased compromise
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I don't want to launch with the checkout problem. What would you suggest?”
successCriteria: The learner can propose a phased compromise in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Let's fix checkout now …”

stages.title: Agree on who will take the next action
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “That works. I'll draft a proposal today. What can you take on?”
successCriteria: The learner can agree on who will take the next action in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'll check with engineering …”
